The interaction between the finger/object and the liquid is physically ambiguous. There is no clear displacement, ripple, or wetness trail on the finger. The liquid surface looks like a flat gray matte texture rather than a reflective fluid.
The connection point of the handle to the cup body near the thumb is slightly soft and indistinct, making the structural attachment look weak compared to the sharp rim.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'dipping finger' action. AI often fails to render the meniscus, ripples, or wetness on objects entering liquids. Also, scrutinize the hand anatomy; AI frequently generates extra joints or merges fingers when they are curled around objects. The black and white filter may hide color artifacts but exaggerate texture smoothing.
